_layers.feedback: Stage 9: LLM wording from evidence JSON

_status.experimental: measured + normed + validated, not used for feedback yet

sentence.speech_rate_wpm.name: speech_rate_wpm
sentence.speech_rate_wpm.definition: Words / sentence duration (VAD-trimmed, includes internal pauses). Only for sentences >= 4 s and >= 5 words. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

sentence.artic_rate_sps.name: artic_rate_sps
sentence.artic_rate_sps.definition: Articulation rate: syllables / VAD speech time within the sentence (pauses excluded). Syllables from an orthographic heuristic on the verbatim ASR. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

sentence.artic_rate_wpm.name: artic_rate_wpm
sentence.artic_rate_wpm.definition: Words / VAD speech time within the sentence. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

sentence.pitch_std_st.name: pitch_std_st
sentence.pitch_std_st.definition: Std of voiced F0 (st re. speaker median) in the sentence.

sentence.pitch_range_st.name: pitch_range_st
sentence.pitch_range_st.definition: p95 - p5 of voiced F0 (st) in the sentence.

sentence.f0_median_st.name: f0_median_st
sentence.f0_median_st.definition: Median voiced F0 of the sentence relative to the speaker's overall median (raised pitch = stress proxy).

sentence.intensity_std_db.name: intensity_std_db
sentence.intensity_std_db.definition: Std of Praat intensity over VAD-speech frames in the sentence. Gain-invariant (energy variability, not level).

sentence.intensity_mean_db.name: intensity_mean_db
sentence.intensity_mean_db.definition: Mean intensity over speech frames. ABSOLUTE LEVEL: depends on microphone/gain; never feedback (Stage 0).

sentence.voiced_frac.name: voiced_frac
sentence.voiced_frac.definition: Voiced pitch frames / speech frames in the sentence.

segment.speech_rate_wpm.name: speech_rate_wpm
segment.speech_rate_wpm.definition: Words / answer duration (VAD-trimmed, includes internal pauses). Duration = first to last speech. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.artic_rate_sps.name: artic_rate_sps
segment.artic_rate_sps.definition: Articulation rate: syllables / VAD speech time within the answer (pauses excluded). Syllables from an orthographic heuristic on the verbatim ASR. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.artic_rate_wpm.name: artic_rate_wpm
segment.artic_rate_wpm.definition: Words / VAD speech time within the answer. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.pitch_std_st.name: pitch_std_st
segment.pitch_std_st.definition: Std of voiced F0 (st re. speaker median) in the answer.

segment.pitch_range_st.name: pitch_range_st
segment.pitch_range_st.definition: p95 - p5 of voiced F0 (st) in the answer.

segment.f0_median_st.name: f0_median_st
segment.f0_median_st.definition: Median voiced F0 of the answer relative to the speaker's overall median (raised pitch = stress proxy).

segment.intensity_std_db.name: intensity_std_db
segment.intensity_std_db.definition: Std of Praat intensity over VAD-speech frames in the answer. Gain-invariant (energy variability, not level).

segment.intensity_mean_db.name: intensity_mean_db
segment.intensity_mean_db.definition: Mean intensity over speech frames. ABSOLUTE LEVEL: depends on microphone/gain; never feedback (Stage 0).

segment.voiced_frac.name: voiced_frac
segment.voiced_frac.definition: Voiced pitch frames / speech frames in the answer.

sentence.duration_s.name: duration_s
sentence.duration_s.definition: VAD-trimmed sentence duration (first to last speech in the window).

sentence.speech_time_s.name: speech_time_s
sentence.speech_time_s.definition: VAD speech time inside the sentence window.

sentence.n_words.name: n_words
sentence.n_words.definition: Words in the sentence (verbatim ASR; fillers removed by RecruitView). [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

sentence.n_mid_pauses.name: n_mid_pauses
sentence.n_mid_pauses.definition: Mid-sentence VAD pauses >= 0.25 s in this sentence. [Stage 4: mid-sentence = the ASR words on both sides of the pause belong to the same sentence.]

sentence.max_mid_pause_s.name: max_mid_pause_s
sentence.max_mid_pause_s.definition: Longest mid-sentence pause in this sentence (0 if none).

sentence.end_drop_db.name: end_drop_db
sentence.end_drop_db.definition: Syllable-peak level (p80 intensity) in the last 0.7 s of the sentence's speech minus the sentence's p80 (negative = trailing off). Gain-invariant; dropout frames excluded; NaN when the tail is within 10 dB of the clip background (VAD padding, not speech). [Stage 4: measured at real sentence ends (ASR punctuation), not transcript line breaks.]

sentence.terminal_slope_st_s.name: terminal_slope_st_s
sentence.terminal_slope_st_s.definition: Linear F0 slope over the 0.3 s before the end of the sentence's last voiced run (>= 5 consecutive voiced frames; positive = rising / uptalk). [Stage 4: measured at real sentence ends (ASR punctuation), not transcript line breaks.]

segment.speech_span_s.name: speech_span_s
segment.speech_span_s.definition: First to last VAD speech (answer length without leading/trailing silence).

segment.word_count.name: word_count
segment.word_count.definition: Words in the verbatim ASR. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.syllable_count.name: syllable_count
segment.syllable_count.definition: Heuristic syllables (used for articulation rate). [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.n_sentences.name: n_sentences
segment.n_sentences.definition: ASR sentences. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.sent_rate_mean_wpm.name: sent_rate_mean_wpm
segment.sent_rate_mean_wpm.definition: Mean per-sentence speech rate over sentences >= 4 s. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.sent_rate_max_wpm.name: sent_rate_max_wpm
segment.sent_rate_max_wpm.definition: Fastest sentence (>= 4 s). [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.sent_rate_std_wpm.name: sent_rate_std_wpm
segment.sent_rate_std_wpm.definition: Rate variability: std of per-sentence rates (needs >= 2 sentences >= 4 s). [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.sent_rate_cv.name: sent_rate_cv
segment.sent_rate_cv.definition: Rate variability normalised by the mean (std / mean). [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.rushed_opening_ratio.name: rushed_opening_ratio
segment.rushed_opening_ratio.definition: Speech rate of the first 2 sentences / rate of the rest (needs >= 3 sentences, each part >= 4 s). > 1 = faster opening. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.rate_drift_ratio.name: rate_drift_ratio
segment.rate_drift_ratio.definition: Speech rate in the last third of the answer / first third (by time; needs a speech span >= 12 s). < 1 = slowing down. [Stage 4: words from verbatim ASR (faster-whisper medium.en), filled pauses excluded; sentences end at ASR punctuation.]

segment.response_latency_s.name: response_latency_s
segment.response_latency_s.definition: Silence before the first VAD speech.

segment.pause_ratio.name: pause_ratio
segment.pause_ratio.definition: Internal non-speech time / speech span (all VAD gaps).

segment.mid_pause_rate_per_min.name: mid_pause_rate_per_min
segment.mid_pause_rate_per_min.definition: Mid-sentence pauses >= 0.25 s per minute of speech span. [Stage 4: mid-sentence = the ASR words on both sides of the pause belong to the same sentence.]

segment.long_mid_pause_rate_per_min.name: long_mid_pause_rate_per_min
segment.long_mid_pause_rate_per_min.definition: Mid-sentence pauses >= 1.0 s per minute. [Stage 4: mid-sentence = the ASR words on both sides of the pause belong to the same sentence.]

segment.mid_pause_max_s.name: mid_pause_max_s
segment.mid_pause_max_s.definition: Longest mid-sentence pause in the answer (0 if none). [Stage 4: mid-sentence = the ASR words on both sides of the pause belong to the same sentence.]

segment.mid_pause_time_ratio.name: mid_pause_time_ratio
segment.mid_pause_time_ratio.definition: Mid-sentence pause time / speech span. [Stage 4: mid-sentence = the ASR words on both sides of the pause belong to the same sentence.]

segment.between_pause_time_ratio.name: between_pause_time_ratio
segment.between_pause_time_ratio.definition: Between-sentence pause time / speech span. [Stage 4: mid-sentence = the ASR words on both sides of the pause belong to the same sentence.]

segment.internal_pause_count.name: internal_pause_count
segment.internal_pause_count.definition: Raw count of internal pauses >= 0.25 s. Tracks answer length (Stage 0); use the rates instead.

segment.monotony_frac.name: monotony_frac
segment.monotony_frac.definition: Fraction of 5-s windows (hop 2.5 s, >= 1 s voiced) with pitch std < 1.5 st.

segment.end_drop_median_db.name: end_drop_median_db
segment.end_drop_median_db.definition: Median sentence end_drop_db over the answer.

segment.f0_median_hz.name: f0_median_hz
segment.f0_median_hz.definition: Median F0 in Hz. ABSOLUTE: identifies the voice; never feedback.

segment.octave_jump_frac.name: octave_jump_frac
segment.octave_jump_frac.definition: Adjacent voiced frames differing by > 9 st (pitch-tracking error rate).

segment.dropout_frac.name: dropout_frac
segment.dropout_frac.definition: Fraction of VAD-speech intensity frames that are digital silence (recording dropouts). Input to the Stage 6 quality gate.

segment.isolated_blips_removed.name: isolated_blips_removed
segment.isolated_blips_removed.definition: VAD speech islands < 0.3 s isolated by >= 1.0 s of silence, removed before measuring.

segment.transcript_timing_suspect.name: transcript_timing_suspect
segment.transcript_timing_suspect.definition: Some transcript line implies > 8 syllables/s (text does not match its timestamps); affected rates are withheld.

segment.is_duplicate.name: is_duplicate
segment.is_duplicate.definition: Byte-identical audio to a lower id (RecruitView duplicate recording). Exclude when fitting reference distributions.

sentence.timing_suspect.name: timing_suspect
sentence.timing_suspect.definition: Line implies > 8 syllables/s; its rates are withheld.

sentence.n_filled_pauses.name: n_filled_pauses
sentence.n_filled_pauses.definition: um / uh / erm / hmm tokens in the sentence. Filler counting and filler feedback belong to the TEXT branch (it receives words.csv); kept here only to check the ASR and to exclude fillers from speech rate.

sentence.asr_prob_mean.name: asr_prob_mean
sentence.asr_prob_mean.definition: Mean Whisper word probability (filled pauses excluded): intelligibility proxy. Also drops with noise and accent, so it waits for the Stage 6 quality gate and Stage 7-8 validation.

segment.filled_pause_count.name: filled_pause_count
segment.filled_pause_count.definition: um / uh / erm / hmm tokens in the answer. Filler counting and filler feedback belong to the TEXT branch (it receives words.csv); kept here only to check the ASR and to exclude fillers from speech rate.

segment.filled_pause_rate_per_min.name: filled_pause_rate_per_min
segment.filled_pause_rate_per_min.definition: Filled pauses per minute of speech span. Filler counting and filler feedback belong to the TEXT branch (it receives words.csv); kept here only to check the ASR and to exclude fillers from speech rate.

segment.asr_prob_mean.name: asr_prob_mean
segment.asr_prob_mean.definition: Mean Whisper word probability over the answer.

segment.asr_words_outside_vad.name: asr_words_outside_vad
segment.asr_words_outside_vad.definition: ASR words with no VAD speech within 0.1 s (likely hallucinations); removed before measuring.

segment.transcript_word_count.name: transcript_word_count
segment.transcript_word_count.definition: Words in the cleaned RecruitView transcript (Stage 1).

segment.asr_transcript_word_ratio.name: asr_transcript_word_ratio
segment.asr_transcript_word_ratio.definition: ASR words / transcript words. Outside [0.7, 1.4] = the two disagree; listen before trusting either.

segment.asr_repetition_suspect.name: asr_repetition_suspect
segment.asr_repetition_suspect.definition: The same 4-word sequence occurs >= 4 times, or one token >= 5 times in a row (Whisper repetition loop). All word-based rates of the answer are then withheld.

_source: Stage 4: verbatim ASR words and sentences (extract_word_level_descriptors.py)
